Evergreen Capital Management Llc who had been investing in New Gold Inc Cda for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.35 billion market cap company. (NYSEMKT:NGD) has declined 14.62% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.17% the S&P500.
